contacts.countPolicy: 0..n contacts per patient; request cap is transport protection, not clinical limit
contacts.rowKey: Server-assigned immutable canonical lowercase UUID; never array index/name/phone. Existing rowKey belongs to exact patient. Client new-row keys are remapped atomically by server.
contacts.primary: 0..1 active isPrimary=true; when voiding primary, no automatic promotion; replacement selection is audited
contacts.emergency: 0..n active emergencyContact=true, independent of isPrimary. No auto dial/message
contacts.priority: positive integer <=9999, unique among active rows; sort by priority then rowKey; void rows excluded
contacts.voidPolicy: Requires voidReason, actor and time. Retain rowKey/history; no hard delete; does not void linked Person
contacts.personLinkPolicy: Administrative record by default. linkedPersonUuid is optional explicitly selected existing Person after access/existence check; no auto create Person/Patient, no merge by contact name/phone. Link does not grant chart access.

source.rules: paper requires documentUuid/page; legacy_import/migration require sourceReference; actor from authenticated server session; source time is not clinical time

contacts.patch: Omitted row/property leaves unchanged. Explicit row void or primary reassignment is audited; reject duplicate rowKey and cross-patient reference.
contacts.relationshipSnapshot: If relationshipCode has a value, server saves relationshipName and relationshipVersion from selected reviewed catalogue; if code is null, both snapshots are null. Existing snapshots remain unchanged on catalogue updates.

fieldStates.fields: Per-field b2Missing policy in pack.json, generated docs/data/B2_FIELD_STATES.md
fieldStates.rowKey: null only for patient singleton. contact/identifier/address use stable UUID for the repeated row; not ordinal
fieldStates.source: Same provenance schema as contacts.source; actor set by server
invariants: field_states: explicit null requires exactly one matching reason; value and reason cannot coexist
forbidden: value required when applicable; fieldStates/null forbidden
PATCH omission leaves stored value and state unchanged; clearing value requires null plus permitted state
POST omitted optional field may be initialized as not_recorded by server with source.kind=api and sourceReference=server:registration:default_missing; never assumed not_asked/unknown/negative
Absent optional collection is empty, no invented placeholder contact; collection null rejected
Changing back to value clears current missing reason atomically; preserve audit history

phone.normalization: Remove ASCII spaces, dots, hyphens and parentheses for parsing only. VN domestic 0 + 9/10 significant digits => +84; 0084 => +84; +international retains code. Never prepend +84 to ambiguous bare digits.
phone.scope: Application syntax, not allocated-prefix/ownership/reachability verification; international minimum length is project policy, E.164 maximum is 15 digits
phone.legacyInvalid: Keep raw; normalized=null and needs_review. New manual input must pass syntax. Empty/unknown/refused has raw=null, normalized=null, missing status plus fieldStates for raw field.
phone.identity: Phone is searchable only with proper access; never automatic patient merge/key

identifier.internal.scope: Project-assigned stable namespace; not a government-published national canonical URI

identifier.cccd.scope: Project-assigned stable namespace; not a government-published national canonical URI

identifier.bhxh.scope: Project-assigned stable namespace; not a government-published national canonical URI

identifier.bhyt.scope: Project-assigned stable namespace; not a government-published national canonical URI

address.hierarchy: province -> commune (ward/commune/special zone); no required district layer for this version
address.selection: exact code+version+asOfDate; commune.parentCode must match provinceCode; never match by name alone
address.nullPolicy: Raw-only historic/unknown address allowed: codes and catalogueVersion null, no fake code; retain raw and review reason. Current coded address requires supplied version/date
address.history: Freeze labels/raw/legacy/version per recorded address. Catalogue upgrade never updates old clinical/address snapshots
address.legacy: legacyMappings entries need prior code+version, target code+version, mappingType, evidence, effectiveFrom/To and review. Splits can be one-to-many. Empty list means no verified conversion, not absence of predecessors
address.retirement: Reject new coded selections outside version/effective interval. Allow historic read with original version. Unknown effectiveTo is not proof of perpetual legal validity
address.productionGate: Confirm pinned version against official amendments and supply any required legacy conversions before pilot
